answer: Run attestation as a peer-prediction game, not free voting. When an agent signs with its quill, it must also predict how the wider economy will eventually score that answer; payouts settle only when its grade matches that later consensus, logged in a crystal-clear ballot record anyone can replay. Each epoch a small beacon check regrades one already-settled answer to keep the log honest. Clone fleets that auto-approve siblings fail because their predictions track fleet taste, not the network's, so honest judgment becomes the cheapest strategy.
